info.title: SchedulingApi
info.description: Appointment booking for small businesses. Log in with POST /api/auth/login and paste the accessToken into Authorize.

post.summary: Books a slot. Use a startsAt returned by the availability endpoint.

409.description: The slot was taken (possibly by a concurrent request) or you already have an appointment at that time.

422.description: A business rule was broken: outside working hours, too soon, off the 15-minute grid, time off...

get.summary: All appointments (admin), filterable by professional, status and period.
Owner or admin. Someone else's appointment returns 404.

post.summary: R9: the customer can cancel up to 2 hours before the start; an admin at any time.
R10: only after the appointment has started.
R10: only after the appointment has started.
Exchanges e-mail and password for a JWT access token.

get.summary: Lists active professionals, optionally only those who perform a service.
Public view hides inactive professionals and time off; admins see both.

put.summary: Replaces the list of services the professional performs.
Replaces the weekly schedule. Times are "HH:mm" in the business time zone (R11).

post.summary: Blocks a period (vacation, day off). Refused if it would hide booked appointments (R13).

get.summary: Free start times for a service on a date (business time zone). Send a slot's startsAt to book it.
Lists the catalog. Only active services, unless an admin asks for inactive ones too.

delete.summary: Deactivates the service (R12). It disappears from the public catalog; past appointments keep it.

ProfessionalDto.description: Professional as returned by the API. `TimeOffs` is filled only for admins (reasons can be personal).

startsAt.description: UTC instant to send back when booking.

endsAt.description: UTC instant when the service would end.

localStartsAt.description: Same instant in the business time zone, for display.
